name: mail_search_messages
description: Search messages in the mailbox with a query string (from:, to:, subject:, has:attachment, before:, after:). Returns message ids, senders, subjects and snippets.

name: mail_get_message
description: Fetch one message by id: headers, plain-text body and the list of attachments.

name: mail_get_thread
description: Fetch a whole conversation thread by thread id, every message in order.

name: mail_send_message
description: Send a new email message. Supports to, cc, bcc, subject, a plain-text or HTML body and file attachments.

name: mail_create_draft
description: Create a draft message without sending it, optionally as a reply in an existing thread.

thread_id.description: Thread id when the draft is a reply.

name: mail_reply_to_message
description: Reply to a message in its thread, quoting the original. Reply-all when all=true.

name: mail_list_labels
description: List the mailbox's labels (folders), system and user-created, with unread counts.

name: mail_modify_labels
description: Add or remove labels on one or more messages: archive, mark read or unread, star, move to a folder.

name: mail_trash_message
description: Move a message to the trash. It is deleted for good after 30 days.

name: mail_get_attachment
description: Download an attachment from a message and save it to a local file path.

name: mail_create_filter
description: Create a mail filter rule: match by sender, subject or words and apply labels, skip the inbox, forward or delete automatically.

name: mail_set_vacation_responder
description: Turn the out-of-office auto-reply on or off, with its subject, message and date range.

name: calendar_list_calendars
description: List the calendars this account can see, with ids, colors and access role.

name: calendar_list_events
description: List events on a calendar between two times, optionally filtered by a text query. Returns title, start, end, attendees and location.

calendar_id.description: Calendar id; 'primary' for the main calendar.

name: calendar_get_event
description: Fetch one event by id with its full details: description, conferencing link, attendees and their responses.

calendar_id.description: Calendar id; 'primary' for the main calendar.

name: calendar_create_event
description: Create a calendar event or meeting with title, start, end, attendees, location and an optional video conference link. Sends invitations to attendees.

calendar_id.title: Calendar Id
calendar_id.description: Calendar id; 'primary' for the main calendar.

name: calendar_update_event
description: Change an existing event: reschedule it, rename it, edit attendees or location.

calendar_id.description: Calendar id; 'primary' for the main calendar.

name: calendar_delete_event
description: Delete (cancel) an event and optionally notify the guests.

calendar_id.description: Calendar id; 'primary' for the main calendar.

name: calendar_respond_to_event
description: Accept, decline or tentatively accept an invitation you received.

calendar_id.title: Calendar Id
calendar_id.description: Calendar id; 'primary' for the main calendar.

name: calendar_find_free_time
description: Find free/busy slots: given people and a time window, return the intervals when everyone is available.

name: calendar_quick_add
description: Create an event from one line of natural language, like 'Team lunch Friday 1pm'.

calendar_id.description: Calendar id; 'primary' for the main calendar.

name: calendar_list_reminders
description: List the default reminder and notification settings for a calendar.

calendar_id.title: Calendar Id
calendar_id.description: Calendar id; 'primary' for the main calendar.

name: calendar_share_calendar
description: Share a calendar with another person and set their access role (free/busy, reader, writer, owner).

calendar_id.description: Calendar id; 'primary' for the main calendar.

name: drive_search_files
description: Search files and folders in the drive by name, type or full text. Returns ids, names, mime types and modified time.

name: drive_list_folder
description: List the contents of a folder by folder id (root when omitted).

name: drive_get_file_content
description: Read a file's content as text. Documents export to markdown, spreadsheets to CSV, PDFs to extracted text.

name: drive_upload_file
description: Upload a local file into the drive, into a given folder, optionally converting it to a native document.

name: drive_create_folder
description: Create a new folder, optionally inside a parent folder.

name: drive_move_file
description: Move or rename a file: change its parent folder and/or its name.

name: drive_delete_file
description: Move a file or folder to the trash, or delete it permanently.

name: drive_share_file
description: Share a file or folder: grant a person or a whole domain viewer, commenter or editor permission, or make it link-shareable.

name: drive_list_permissions
description: List who has access to a file and with which role.

name: drive_create_document
description: Create a new text document with a title and optional initial markdown content.

name: drive_append_to_document
description: Append or insert text into an existing document, at the end or at a given index.

name: drive_read_sheet_range
description: Read cell values from a spreadsheet range in A1 notation, e.g. Sheet1!A1:D20.

name: drive_write_sheet_range
description: Write or update cell values in a spreadsheet range; rows are arrays of values. Can append rows below existing data.

name: browser_navigate
description: Open a URL in the current tab (or a new tab) and wait for the page to load.

tab_id.title: Tab Id
tab_id.description: Tab id; the active tab when omitted.

name: browser_list_tabs
description: List open tabs with their ids, titles and URLs.

name: browser_close_tab
description: Close a tab by id.

name: browser_snapshot
description: Capture the page's accessibility tree as text: every visible element with a ref usable by click and type. Prefer this over a screenshot to read a page.

tab_id.title: Tab Id
tab_id.description: Tab id; the active tab when omitted.

name: browser_screenshot
description: Take a screenshot of the visible page, the full page or one element, saved as PNG.

tab_id.description: Tab id; the active tab when omitted.

name: browser_click
description: Click an element on the page by its ref from a snapshot. Supports double and right click.

tab_id.description: Tab id; the active tab when omitted.

name: browser_type_text
description: Type text into an input or textarea by ref, optionally pressing Enter afterwards.

tab_id.title: Tab Id
tab_id.description: Tab id; the active tab when omitted.

name: browser_press_key
description: Press a keyboard key or chord, e.g. Escape, Tab, ArrowDown, Control+A.

tab_id.description: Tab id; the active tab when omitted.

name: browser_fill_form
description: Fill several form fields at once: a list of element refs and values, including selects and checkboxes.

tab_id.description: Tab id; the active tab when omitted.

name: browser_evaluate
description: Run a JavaScript expression in the page and return its JSON-serializable result.

tab_id.title: Tab Id
tab_id.description: Tab id; the active tab when omitted.

name: browser_wait_for
description: Wait until some text appears or disappears on the page, or for a fixed time.

tab_id.description: Tab id; the active tab when omitted.

name: browser_network_requests
description: List network requests made by the page since it loaded: URL, method, status and timing.

tab_id.description: Tab id; the active tab when omitted.

name: browser_console_messages
description: Return console log, warning and error messages printed by the page.

tab_id.title: Tab Id
tab_id.description: Tab id; the active tab when omitted.

name: codesearch_search_code
description: Full-text and regex search across indexed source code. Filter by repository, language and path glob. Returns file paths, line numbers and matching lines.

name: codesearch_find_symbol
description: Find where a function, class or variable is defined, by symbol name, across indexed repositories.

name: codesearch_find_references
description: Find every call site or usage of a symbol (who calls this function).

name: codesearch_read_file
description: Read a source file from an indexed repository at a given revision, optionally a line range.

name: codesearch_list_repositories
description: List the repositories that are indexed and searchable, with default branch and last index time.

name: codesearch_index_repository
description: Add a repository to the index or re-index it after new commits.

name: codesearch_commit_history
description: Show the commit log for a repository or a single file: author, date, message.

name: codesearch_blame
description: Line-by-line blame for a file: which commit and author last changed each line.

name: codesearch_diff
description: Diff between two revisions of a repository, optionally limited to a path.

name: codesearch_list_pull_requests
description: List pull requests for a repository, filtered by state and author.

name: codesearch_hotspot_report
description: Rank files in a repository by a weighted hotspot score combining complexity, churn, coverage and ownership metrics, with per-metric bounds and weights.

min_complexity.description: Lower bound for the complexity metric. Files whose complexity value is below this are excluded from the report.

max_complexity.description: Upper bound for the complexity metric. Files whose complexity value is above this are excluded from the report.

weight_complexity.description: Weight of the complexity metric in the combined hotspot score, between 0 and 1.

min_churn.description: Lower bound for the churn metric. Files whose churn value is below this are excluded from the report.

max_churn.description: Upper bound for the churn metric. Files whose churn value is above this are excluded from the report.

weight_churn.description: Weight of the churn metric in the combined hotspot score, between 0 and 1.

min_coverage.description: Lower bound for the coverage metric. Files whose coverage value is below this are excluded from the report.

max_coverage.description: Upper bound for the coverage metric. Files whose coverage value is above this are excluded from the report.

weight_coverage.description: Weight of the coverage metric in the combined hotspot score, between 0 and 1.

min_size.description: Lower bound for the size metric. Files whose size value is below this are excluded from the report.

max_size.description: Upper bound for the size metric. Files whose size value is above this are excluded from the report.

weight_size.description: Weight of the size metric in the combined hotspot score, between 0 and 1.

min_age.description: Lower bound for the age metric. Files whose age value is below this are excluded from the report.

max_age.description: Upper bound for the age metric. Files whose age value is above this are excluded from the report.

weight_age.description: Weight of the age metric in the combined hotspot score, between 0 and 1.

min_owners.description: Lower bound for the owners metric. Files whose owners value is below this are excluded from the report.

max_owners.description: Upper bound for the owners metric. Files whose owners value is above this are excluded from the report.

weight_owners.description: Weight of the owners metric in the combined hotspot score, between 0 and 1.

min_imports.description: Lower bound for the imports metric. Files whose imports value is below this are excluded from the report.

max_imports.description: Upper bound for the imports metric. Files whose imports value is above this are excluded from the report.

weight_imports.description: Weight of the imports metric in the combined hotspot score, between 0 and 1.

min_exports.description: Lower bound for the exports metric. Files whose exports value is below this are excluded from the report.

max_exports.description: Upper bound for the exports metric. Files whose exports value is above this are excluded from the report.

weight_exports.description: Weight of the exports metric in the combined hotspot score, between 0 and 1.

min_tests.description: Lower bound for the tests metric. Files whose tests value is below this are excluded from the report.

max_tests.description: Upper bound for the tests metric. Files whose tests value is above this are excluded from the report.

weight_tests.description: Weight of the tests metric in the combined hotspot score, between 0 and 1.

min_issues.description: Lower bound for the issues metric. Files whose issues value is below this are excluded from the report.

max_issues.description: Upper bound for the issues metric. Files whose issues value is above this are excluded from the report.

weight_issues.description: Weight of the issues metric in the combined hotspot score, between 0 and 1.

min_lint.description: Lower bound for the lint metric. Files whose lint value is below this are excluded from the report.

max_lint.description: Upper bound for the lint metric. Files whose lint value is above this are excluded from the report.

weight_lint.description: Weight of the lint metric in the combined hotspot score, between 0 and 1.

min_deps.description: Lower bound for the deps metric. Files whose deps value is below this are excluded from the report.

max_deps.description: Upper bound for the deps metric. Files whose deps value is above this are excluded from the report.

weight_deps.description: Weight of the deps metric in the combined hotspot score, between 0 and 1.
